how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Guwahati Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Scientist: Ph.D. in VLSI/Microelectronics/CS OR MTech/ME in VLSI/Microelectronics/CS with 2 Years of relevant experience OR BTech/BE in EC/EE/CS with 4 years relevant experience Assistant Project Engineer: Bachelor's degree in EC/EE/CS with background of RTL Design/Data Verification OR DFT/Synthesis OR Physical Design, Signoff, Analog Lab Assistant: B.Sc. with 65% or 7 CGPA and above OR Diploma in Engineering and Technology with 65% or 7 CGPA and above, preferably with min. 2 years experience Scientific Administrative Assistant: MSc/BSc in Electronics/CSE/IT OR Diploma in Engineering and Technology, preferably with min. 1 years of work experience

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Guwahati recruitment is 13-08-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for various posts, with 3 vacancies specifically for the Project Scientist position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Scientist position is 68450 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Assistant Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in EC/EE/CS with a background in RTL Design/Data Verification OR DFT/Synthesis OR Physical Design, Signoff, Analog is required for the Assistant Project Engineer post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly provided in the extracted data and should be confirmed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only through the official website of IIT Guwahati.
